decisions.reason: This compact dumper is close to the firm's established construction-equipment and vehicle know-how, so its strong absorptive capacity and service network make continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.

An articulated construction dumper fits very well with the firm's existing engineering base, customer set and application knowledge, giving management good scope to learn from initial market feedback and improve it.

The underground mine rescue vehicle is technologically related to the firm's underground-specialist business, but its narrower niche demand makes it somewhat more exposed even though the firm has the knowledge to develop it further.

A compact telescopic loader line with several models signals a deeper commitment in an area closely connected to the firm's lifting and construction capabilities, so management would be unlikely to remove it after only one year.
